name: runsaturday
description: RunSaturday — find your best 5K this Saturday. Independent app; not affiliated with parkrun.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @runsaturday/api" "npm run dev -w @runsaturday/web"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:demo -w @runsaturday/api" "npm run dev -w @runsaturday/web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
